title: Discrepancy
description:
One mismatch between computed holdings and a depository- or broker-declared quantity. Source of truth: docs/ENGINE_SPEC.md section 7.

This is the corporate-action detector. A mismatch means exactly one of: a corporate action, an off-market transfer, a missed contract note, or a bug. All four need a human; all four are invisible without this check.

computed_qty.description: What replaying the ledger says the investor holds.

declared_qty.description: What the CAS or broker statement says. Used to CHECK the engine, never as a source of truth for display.

ratio.description: declared_qty / computed_qty. Null when computed_qty is zero. The cause heuristics key off this: about 2 suggests a 1:1 bonus or 1:2 split, about 3 a 1:2 bonus or 1:3 split, about 5 or 10 a split.

likely_cause.description: Human-readable diagnosis from the ratio heuristics table in ENGINE_SPEC section 7. A hypothesis for a human to confirm, never an instruction to auto-correct the ledger.
